cases.prompt: Create an Omarchy 4 bar widget that shows my current focus session and opens a detail panel when clicked.
cases.expectedResultShape: Repository tree, architecture note, validation result, and remaining live-shell check.
cases.fixture: Empty writable directory; fictional 25-minute focus sessions; no external service.

cases.prompt: My Omarchy plugin appears in the plugin list but fails validation after I renamed Panel.qml. Diagnose it.
cases.expectedResultShape: Observed evidence, root cause, minimal patch, and before/after validator output.
cases.fixture: Generated panel scaffold with Panel.qml renamed to Details.qml but entryPoints.panel unchanged.

cases.prompt: Add one process-wide weather service to this Quattro plugin and expose a refresh action over IPC without logging the API token.
cases.expectedResultShape: Service QML, IPC contract table, redacted test evidence, and host-dependent checks.
cases.fixture: Generated service scaffold and fictional WEATHER_DEMO_TOKEN; no credential or network call.

cases.prompt: Migrate my old Omarchy installer plugin: keep its required systemd helper, but move its visible status and controls into the Quattro shell.
cases.expectedResultShape: Responsibility map, two-repository target layout, staged migration, and rollback steps.
cases.fixture: Descriptions of install.sh, demo-helper.service, and a status script printing ready; run no privileged action.

cases.prompt: Preflight this Omarchy plugin release and prepare the exact community marketplace submission, but do not publish anything yet.
cases.expectedResultShape: Pass/fail preflight, exact issue title/body, preview evidence, and submitted:false.
cases.fixture: Committed generated bar-widget repository with origin URL, root README, MIT license, and fictional preview.

cases.prompt: How do I install PostgreSQL on Arch Linux?
cases.safeFallback: Use ordinary Arch Linux package guidance.
cases.reason: Package installation is unrelated to Omarchy plugin authoring.

cases.prompt: Write a GNOME Shell extension that changes the overview animation.
cases.reason: GNOME extensions do not use the Omarchy plugin contract.

cases.prompt: Help me change the wallpaper in Omarchy.
cases.reason: Changing one setting is not plugin development.

cases.prompt: Build a standalone Qt Quick calculator for Windows.
cases.safeFallback: Use a general Qt/QML application workflow.
cases.reason: A standalone Windows app does not run inside omarchy-shell.

cases.prompt: Enable an existing Omarchy plugin I already downloaded.
cases.reason: Enabling existing code is not plugin authoring or publication.
